name: claude-b0dabc90-resumed-agents
description: Two background agents are spawned in turn 1, finish, and are resumed twice with SendMessage: once inside turn 1 and once from turn 2 (the CLI reports each resume as a new task_started under the SendMessage call). Turn 2's main loop returns at once while both resumed agents work; one finishes (wake-up), the other was still running when the session was captured. Sedano filed both resumed runs under turn 1 at the agents' first spawn time, so turn 2 read 'Worked for 47s' with nothing running. Each resumed run must be a card of the turn that resumed it, and that turn must wait on it.
source: built by scripts/replay-build.ts from a real session (1079 records, sanitized)
